overview.text: Aaron “Jitu” Brown is the incumbent board member for District 5a, elected in 2024. He is the national director of the Journey for Justice Alliance, which opposes public school privatization. He was an education organizer for the Kenwood Oakland Community Organization. In 2015, he took part in a hunger strike to keep Dyett High School open.
